$comment: INFERRED schema — the real InfoPath form has 47 fields; this models 9 header fields plus a repeating areas-gritted child list as a best-effort reconstruction from the form name and domain context (site winter maintenance), pending the real .xsn or a walkthrough. See ../README.md.

lists.listDescription: Header record for a gritting (salting) round: date, weather, and who carried it out.

fields.notes: Plain text time-of-day (e.g. '06:30') rather than a full DateTime, matching how shift logs are typically recorded.
Set by the app/flow from the areas-gritted child list, not typed in directly.

lists.listDescription: Repeating detail: each site area covered (or missed) during a gritting round. Lookup back to Gritting Log — InfoPath's repeating table for this form becomes a child list, per the migration guide.

fields.notes: e.g. pedestrian walkways, steps, loading bays — drives the flow's alert if left incomplete.

notes: 9 header fields + 5 area-row fields modeled vs. 47 total in the real form — likely missing fields include equipment used, named operators per area, or additional site/zone breakdowns. Confirm against the real .xsn.

AllAreasComplete on Gritting Log is written by the Power Automate flow (see ../powerautomate/flows/Notify-IncompleteGritting.json) based on the Gritting Log Areas rows, not typed in by the person logging.
